# Scaling: lex1dx tuned / sig5 (k-preserving grouping, raw-data Refine) vs Grønlund wilber-interp

One warm-up and 3 timed reps; times are medians, in seconds. **Comparison is post-sort only**: every method is given the same array, already sorted with `std::sort` (that sort is timed separately and logged as `sort_s`; it is not added to `post_s`). lex1dx **tuned** uses full-precision atoms, tuned Collapse, weighted wilber DP, Refine. lex1dx **sig5** always groups to 5 significant digits (no D′ guard), then the same pipeline; D and D′ are logged so a rule can be derived later. M = max(4096, 32k). Exact SSE* is the two-pass long-double SSE of unweighted Grønlund wilber-interp on the sorted points. REE is (SSE − SSE*) / SSE* × 100. Peak RSS is the cell process (`getrusage`).

If a wilber-interp cell timed out or crashed, its row has `status=timeout` or `status=crash` and lex REE is left blank.
